full- src: Terrorists? You surprise me.

full- tr: 뉴욕에서 타일러 휘트니를 한 번 만난 적이 있어요.

full- src: Today you help the Bosnians, tomorrow the English.
full- tr: 오늘은 보스니아인 편, 내일은 영국인 편이겠죠.

full- tr: 타일러가 왜 죽었는지 알고 싶어요? 말해줄게요.

full- src: For a thousand years people have been killing each other over the Balkans.
full- tr: 천 년 동안 사람들은 발칸을 두고 서로 죽여 왔어요.

full- src: It's not about to stop for one American.
full- tr: 미국인 한 명 때문에 멈출 일은 아니에요.

full- src: Our history is a chain of blood.

full- tr: 그 사슬은 먼 과거까지 이어져 우리를 옭아매고 있죠.

full- src: And it has nothing to do with you.

Why don't you go home before the same thing happens to you?
full- tr: 당신도 같은 일을 당하기 전에 집으로 돌아가요.

full- tr: 몇 번이고 자문하오. 내가 착각한 건가?

full- src: A fantasy? A romantic dream?

full- src: The warmth of her eyes.

full- tr: 그리고 알게 되지. 내가 틀리지 않았다는 걸. 그녀가 변했소.

full- src: Well, August, she is an artist.
An artist.
Yes. When I return to Munich, she shall play for me.
full- tr: 그래. 내가 뮌헨으로 돌아가면, 그녀가 나를 위해 연주할 거요.

full- src: She will perform at my house.
Let me fill your glass, Herr Whitney.
You at least, have not disappointed me.
Yes, yes. She will play for me.
full- tr: 그래, 그래. 그녀는 나를 위해 연주할 거요.

full- src: It will be a wonderful evening.

full- tr: 당신도 거기 오게 될 거요, 헤어 휘트니.

full- src: Kronos and the Obolenskys, we shall all be together
full- tr: 크로노스와 오볼렌스키가, 우리 모두 한자리에 모일 거요

Anna.

Why are you following me?

It's just that I'm tired.
You can't imagine how tired I am.
full- tr: 내가 얼마나 지쳤는지 당신은 상상도 못 해요.

Good night.

full- tr: 당신이 캐스든 휘트니든 내겐 중요하지 않습니다.

full- src: I am prepared to continue the discussion begun by my agent in Paris,
full- tr: 파리의 내 대리인이 시작한 논의를 이어갈 준비가 되어 있습니다.

full- src: provided that you have the piece of which you spoke.
full- tr: 당신이 말한 물건을 갖고 있다는 전제하에서요.

full- src: Is Kronos your first name or your last name?

full- tr: 이 유쾌한 이름 이야기를 계속할 시간은 없군요.

I hope you have good news for me today.

full- src: Do you have it?
What happened to Tyler?

full- tr: 미스터 휘트니와 그 동료들의 불운한 소동엔 관심 없습니다.

Miss Wolff.

full- src: Or have you lost count?

They're all dead.
I can't help Tyler. I can't help anyone.
full- tr: 난 타일러를 도울 수 없어요. 아무도 못 도와요.

full- src: You were right. I never should have gotten mixed up in this.
full- tr: 당신 말이 맞았어요. 애초에 이 일에 엮이면 안 됐어요.

full- src: And neither should you.
At least I'm serving my country.
full- tr: 적어도 난 내 나라를 위해 일하고 있어요.

full- src: What country?
You're Jewish, you speak German, you come from Hungary.
full- tr: 당신은 유대인이고, 독일어를 쓰고, 헝가리 출신이잖아요.

full- src: What is your country?
My father spent his life in the Austrian military.
My brother was killed in action.
I think that gives me the right to consider myself an Austrian.
full- tr: 그 정도면 스스로를 오스트리아인이라 여길 자격은 충분하다고 생각해요.

full- src: I hope the Emperor appreciates your sacrifice.
What about you?
Once you get to Constantinople, where you will go then?
full- tr: 콘스탄티노플에 도착하면 그다음엔 어디로 갈 건가요?

full- src: To Jerusalem. There's a man there who has a manuscript I'd like to get a look at.
full- tr: 예루살렘으로요. 거기에 꼭 봐야 할 원고를 가진 사람이 있어요.

full- src: Do you want to come with me?
If I only could.
Don't you think the Empire can totter along for a while without your help?
full- tr: 당신 도움 없이도 제국은 한동안 굴러가겠죠, 안 그래요?

full- src: I mean it. Come to Jerusalem with me.
I'm thinking about it.
We should be in Constantinople in an hour.
Where did you get this?
I've... had it for long time.
I've seen this tower before.
full- tr: 이 탑, 전에 본 적 있어요.

full- src: Where?
If I think for a minute, I'll remember.
It's just a design on a ring.
Only an American would say that.
It's a family crest.
The tower, the hand. Every part of it has a meaning.
Maybe they mean he bought it at a flea market.
Don't go away. When I come back, I'll tell you where I saw that tower.
full- tr: 가지 말아요. 돌아오면 그 탑을 어디서 봤는지 말해줄게요.

full- src: Where you going?
Out!
Why don't you make it sing?
Tyler!..
Yes, who is it?
Excuse me, sir.
Pardon me, sir.
Excuse me?
Excuse me, madame.
Oh, excuse me. We seem to be sharing a compartment.
full- tr: 아, 실례합니다. 우리 같은 객실을 쓰게 된 모양이군요.

full- src: No no, please don't get up.
I'll just sit here and read the paper. Don't mind me at all.
full- tr: 저는 그냥 여기 앉아 신문이나 읽을 테니 신경 쓰지 마세요.

full- src: It appears the train's quite full.
Awful nuisance when you think you've got a compartment to yourself and then
they stick a complete stranger in with you at the last minute.
full- tr: 막판에 낯선 사람을 들여보내면 정말 성가시죠.

full- src: Happened to me any number of times.
full- tr: 저도 그런 일을 여러 번 겪었습니다.

full- src: George Abbot
Claude Boutarel
French then, are you?
Are you going all the way to Constantinople?
I am travelling to a small town on the Gulf Coast of Persia.
full- tr: 저는 페르시아만 연안의 작은 마을로 가는 길입니다.

full- src: With my wife and son.
Oh lovely!
Then that must be your family I saw next door.
full- tr: 그럼 옆 객실에서 본 분들이 가족이겠군요.

full- src: It is most probable.
By the way, I was wondering, you haven't seen a red cravat anywhere, have you?
full- tr: 그런데 혹시 빨간 넥타이를 보신 적 있으십니까?

full- src: I was just unpacking and it seems to have disappeared.
I believe my son has taken it.
Really?
What was the name of the town you mentioned?
Masjed-e Soleiman.
Of course! The new oil refinery they're building at Abu Dhabi.
full- tr: 아, 그렇군요! 아바단에 새 정유소를 짓고 있는 그곳 말이죠.

full- src: I say, you're not working for Anglo-Persian, are you?
full- tr: 설마 앵글로-페르시안 회사에서 일하시는 건 아니겠죠?

full- src: Why not?
Well I... suppose you being a Frenchman I just assumed...
full- tr: 아니, 그게... 프랑스 분이라 당연히 아닐 줄 알았습니다...

full- src: I am an engineer, Monsieur.
The Anglo-Persian company is doing the most innovative research in oil exploration.
full- tr: 앵글로-페르시안 회사는 석유 탐사 분야에서 가장 혁신적인 연구를 하고 있습니다.

full- src: Yes. Well, wouldn't want the Royal Navy to be caught short of fuel oil, would we.
full- tr: 그렇군요. 영국 해군의 연료유가 떨어지면 곤란하겠지요.

full- src: Tell me, are the reserves in that little town, what's it called again,
full- tr: 그런데 그 작은 마을, 이름이 뭐더라, 거기 매장량이

full- src: really as big as they say?
I cannot offer an opinion, Monsieur.
No, of course you wouldn't.
Quite brave of your wife to go all that way and live in the desert.
full- tr: 사모님도 대단하시군요. 그렇게 먼 사막까지 따라가시다니.

full- src: She would not wish to be without me.
full- tr: 아내는 저 없이 지내고 싶어 하지 않으니까요.

full- src: And it will be a good opportunity for Fran뇇is. He has a fine scientific mind.
full- tr: 그리고 프랑수아에게도 좋은 기회가 될 겁니다. 과학적 소질이 아주 뛰어나거든요.

full- src: He seems like a very active little boy.
I don't suppose you could ask him for my cravat?
full- tr: 혹시 제 넥타이 좀 돌려달라고 말씀해 주실 수 있겠습니까?

full- src: Ah, I think now... that I remember him using it as a kind of sieve.
full- tr: 아, 이제 생각났군요... 그걸 체처럼 쓰고 있던 것 같습니다.

full- src: To test salinity in the water.
Most remarkable in a boy of 7. Don't you agree?
Quite remarkable.
It is the natural curiosity of the scientific mind, Monsieur.
full- tr: 과학적 정신이 가진 자연스러운 호기심이지요, 무슈.

full- src: Yes, and all that trapped in the body of a little boy.
full- tr: 그렇죠. 그 모든 게 조그만 아이 몸 안에 들어 있다니.

full- src: Oh, excuse me.
No, don't get up.
I'll just sit right here and read my paper.
Seems awfully quiet all of a sudden. I wonder where everyone's got off to.
full- tr: 갑자기 아주 조용해졌군요. 다들 어디로 간 걸까요.

full- src: I believe many passengers are at the concert, Monsieur.
full- tr: 승객 대부분이 연주회에 가신 듯합니다, 무슈.

full- src: Oh yes, I'd forgotten. Of course that would explain it.
full- tr: 아, 맞다. 그걸 깜빡했군요. 그럼 말이 되네요.

full- src: Amazing really when you stop to think about it,
a concert crossing Europe at 60 miles an hour, wonderful thing modern technology.
full- tr: 시속 60마일로 유럽을 달리는 열차 위의 연주회라니, 현대 기술이란 참 대단해요.

full- src: Still, our lot seems to be to sit here and read the paper.
full- tr: 그래도 우리 팔자는 여기 앉아 신문 읽는 거군요.

full- src: You're welcome to Le Figaro, Monsieur. I have read all the articles of interest.
full- tr: 르 피가로를 보셔도 됩니다, 무슈. 흥미로운 기사는 다 읽었거든요.

full- src: Oh, thank you.
Raining again, is it? Beastly weather.
full- tr: 또 비가 오는 건가요? 지독한 날씨군.

full- src: I believe the rain is some distance off, Monsieur.
full- tr: 비구름은 아직 좀 떨어져 있는 듯합니다, 무슈.

full- src: Not for long.
Good afternoon.
Monsieur, welcome.
Please follow me. We have a nice table for you right here in the corner.
full- tr: 이쪽으로 오시죠. 여기 구석에 좋은 자리를 마련해 두었습니다.

full- src: - Thank you. - Enjoy your lunch, monsieur.
Yes Monsieur?
The escalope, that's a sort of veal cutlet, isn't it?
The escalope du veau, yes Monsieur
Well I'll have that, well done please.
Very good Monsieur.
Here you are, monsieur.
Thank you.
Bon appetit, monsieur.
Good afternoon. Mind if I join you?
So dreadfully dull these long journeys. George Abbot, Nobel Industries, London.
full- tr: 긴 여정은 정말 지루하군요. 런던 노벨 인더스트리의 조지 애벗입니다.

full- src: I couldn't help noticing your accent as you were talking to the conductor.
full- tr: 차장과 얘기하시는 걸 들었는데, 억양이 귀에 들어오더군요.

full- src: The Ukraine perhaps?
Your English is impeccable if I may say so.
full- tr: 실례가 안 된다면 영어가 흠잡을 데 없으시군요.

full- src: You must have spent quite some time in England.
I live just outside London myself when I'm home.
full- tr: 저도 집에 있을 땐 런던 외곽에 삽니다.

full- src: The city's just too active for me, dangerous too.
full- tr: 도시는 제겐 너무 번잡하고, 위험하기도 합니다.

full- src: I don't suppose you were there last week when that bomb went off.
full- tr: 지난주 폭탄이 터졌을 때 그곳에 계시진 않았겠지요.

full- src: Awful business. Really, very messy.
Bits of bodies strewed about and so on.
full- tr: 시신 조각이 여기저기 흩어져 있고 말입니다.

full- src: Did you say you were going on to Odessa?
The reason I ask is we happen to be looking for
a representative in that part of the world.
full- tr: 그 지역을 맡을 대리인을 찾고 있어서입니다.

full- src: Preferably a bright young fellow with fluent English and Russian, such as yourself.
full- tr: 되도록이면 당신처럼 영어와 러시아어가 유창한, 총명한 젊은이라면 좋겠고요.

full- src: Of course I realize, with your family background
you probably never considered a career in business.
full- tr: 사업 쪽 진로는 생각해 보신 적 없을 겁니다.

full- src: And of course there's no question of you doing it for money.
full- tr: 물론 돈 때문에 하실 일도 아니고요.

full- src: But after all, you are a member of the new generation.
full- tr: 그래도 결국 당신은 새 세대의 사람 아닙니까.

full- src: It'd be a shame to bury yourself in the countryside,
fiddling with agriculture and so on.
full- tr: 농사나 이런 일만 붙들고 있기엔 아깝지요.

full- src: Why, with your abilities you could literally help build the modern Russia.
full- tr: 당신 실력이면 말 그대로 근대 러시아를 세우는 데 힘을 보탤 수 있습니다.

full- src: Surely you'll agree that Russia must make connection with modern Europe
full- tr: 러시아가 번영하고 발전하려면 현대 유럽과 손을 잡아야 한다는 데

full- src: in order to flourish and develop.
Excuse me.
Oh. Must you go already?
Oh well, do think about it.
Think I'll just stretch my legs for a bit. Excuse me.
full- tr: 잠깐 다리 좀 풀고 오겠습니다. 실례하지요.

full- src: Oh well, my French isn't what it used to be.
full- tr: 아무래도 제 프랑스어가 예전 같지 않군요.

full- src: Never was really. Perhaps I'll just take a walk up to the smoking car.
full- tr: 사실 예전에도 잘하진 못했지요. 흡연칸까지 좀 걸어갔다 와야겠습니다.

full- src: Excuse me I couldn't help wondering,
is that Miss Anna Wolff that was playing the violin just now?
full- tr: 방금 바이올린 켜던 분이 미스 안나 볼프 맞습니까?

full- src: Yes Monsieur, it is our honour to have Miss Wolff travelling with us.
full- tr: 네, 무슈. 미스 볼프께서 동행해 주셔서 저희로선 영광입니다.

full- src: How delightful, and the private car in the back, that wouldn't be um...
full- tr: 참 반갑군요. 그럼 뒤쪽 전용 객차는 설마...

full- src: his excellency Prince Kronos now, would it?
Yes Monsieur.
How interesting. They say he hardly travels at all in Europe any more.
full- tr: 흥미롭군요. 그분은 요즘 유럽에 거의 오시지 않는다고 들었는데요.

full- src: Just goes to show you. I understand Count Obolensky was quite ill during the night.
full- tr: 세상일 알 수 없군요. 오볼렌스키 백작께서 밤사이 꽤 편찮으셨다던데요.

full- src: He's much better today, Monsieur. Fortunately we had a doctor on board.
full- tr: 오늘은 훨씬 나으셨습니다, 무슈. 다행히 열차 안에 의사가 있었습니다.

full- src: A doctor. Not a Russian doctor?
No sir, an American. Monsieur Whitney.
How interesting. Is he actually treating the Count then?
full- tr: 흥미롭군요. 그럼 그분이 실제로 백작님을 진료하고 있습니까?

full- src: He has given him a sedative, Monsieur.
Sedative?
I believe a sort of... herbal tea.
Oh well I'm sure he knows what he's doing. Still it does seem a little irregular.
full- tr: 뭐, 본인이 뭘 하는지는 알겠지요. 그래도 어딘가 정식 진료 같진 않군요.

full- src: Not that we English see anything wrong with a cup of tea,
full- tr: 물론 차 한 잔 자체를 문제 삼는 건 아닙니다만,

full- src: it can do wonders for an upset stomach.
full- tr: 속이 불편할 때는 꽤 효과가 있지요.

full- src: Still one rather expects to see the usual paraphernalia,
full- tr: 그래도 보통은 이런저런 의료 장비가 있어야

full- src: a doctors bag instills confidence and so on.
full- tr: 의사 가방이라도 보여야 믿음이 가지 않겠습니까.

full- src: Given the importance of the patient, I mean.
I suppose Mr Whitney is travelling with quite a bit of luggage.
Monsieur?
Oh you know, so many Americans do.
full- tr: 아, 아시잖습니까. 미국인들은 대개 짐이 많지요.

full- src: I cannot say, Monsieur.
Must be the fellow I passed just now in the smoking car.
full- tr: 방금 흡연칸에서 마주친 사람이 그 양반이었나 보군요.

full- src: Rather young isn't he, for a doctor?
I believe he's young, yes.
I must say he didn't look at all like the usual sort of American
full- tr: 말씀드리자면, 이 열차에서 흔히 보는 미국인과는 전혀 달라 보이더군요.

full- src: one expects to see on these trains, you know, flashing money about.
full- tr: 돈자랑을 요란하게 하는 그런 부류 말입니다.

full- src: Quite the opposite, in fact.
Rather unusual for a young fellow like that to book a double compartment,
full- tr: 그런 젊은 분이 이인실 객실을 잡은 건 꽤 이례적이군요.

full- src: prices being what they are and all that. Wouldn't you say?
full- tr: 요금도 만만치 않은데 말입니다. 안 그렇습니까?

full- src: I do not know Monsieur.
Oh well. I suppose he wants his privacy, nothing wrong with that.
full- tr: 뭐, 사생활을 지키고 싶었겠지요. 나쁠 건 없겠습니다.

full- src: Monsieur, I really must return now.
No, of course, of course... don't let me keep you.
Thank you Monsieur, au revoir.
What's this I hear about the police boarding the train last night?
full- tr: 어젯밤 경찰이 열차에 올라탔다던데, 그게 무슨 일입니까?

full- src: It was most unusual Monsieur. It was the French Gendarmes.
full- tr: 아주 이례적인 일이었습니다, 무슈. 프랑스 헌병대였습니다.

full- src: They find the body of a dead man on the tracks near Paris.
full- tr: 파리 인근 선로에서 시신 하나가 발견됐답니다.

full- src: They think it has been thrown from a train.
Naturally, it was a mistake, it has nothing to do with us.
full- tr: 물론 오해였습니다. 저희와는 아무 관련이 없습니다.

full- src: No, of course not. Ridiculous really, the idea of a murder on the Orient Express.
full- tr: 아, 물론 아니지요. 오리엔트 특급에서 살인이라니, 우스운 얘기군요.

full- src: I don't suppose they happened to mention if they'd identified the body?
I believe it was a foreigner, Monsieur.
Was he? A foreigner. How interesting.
Excuse me, I couldn't help noticing you're by yourself.
Mind if I join you?
Please.
Normally one doesn't go about introducing oneself to complete strangers, but...
full- tr: 보통은 생면부지에게 제 쪽에서 말을 붙이지 않습니다만...

full- src: we lone travellers are a sort of fellowship, aren't we.
full- tr: 혼자 여행하는 처지끼리는 묘한 동지의식이 생기지 않겠습니까.

full- src: George Abbot, Empire Chemicals.
My name is August Schmidt.
Not THE August Schmidt?
The rising young industrialist, A.B. Schmidt and Co,
full- tr: 신진 실업가, A.B. 슈미트 앤드 코...

full- src: munitions, transport, artillery.
One of the stars of the new German industry. I must say I'm very pleased to meet you.
full- tr: 신흥 독일 산업의 총아 중 한 분이지요. 만나 뵙게 되어 정말 반갑습니다.

full- src: You embarrass me sir.
It is true, we do quite a bit of business in England.
Yes, wasn't it your firm that just shipped,
I believe it was 40,000 rifles and a million cartridges into Ulster.
full- tr: 얼스터로 소총 4만 정과 탄약 백만 발을 보냈던 걸로 아는데요.

full- src: No... that was not us.
Oh, oh well. I must be thinking of a different German firm.
full- tr: 아, 그렇군요. 다른 독일 회사를 떠올렸나 봅니다.

full- src: One of your competitors perhaps,
whoever it is, they must be feeling rather disappointed.
It doesn't look like we're in for a civil war after all. Not this week anyway.
full- tr: 결국 내전까지 가진 않을 모양입니다. 적어도 이번 주는요.

full- src: All these troubles in Ireland, it is unfortunate.
full- tr: 아일랜드의 소요 사태는 참 유감스러운 일입니다.

full- src: Yes, yes, it's awful. But really sir, I must congratulate you.
full- tr: 예, 끔찍하지요. 하지만 선생님, 정말 축하드려야겠습니다.

full- src: The recent industrial growth in Germany, most impressive.
full- tr: 최근 독일의 산업 성장은 정말 인상적입니다.

full- src: Really?
Oh yes. Our English businessmen could stand to learn a few things from...
entrepreneurs like yourself.
full- tr: 선생님 같은 기업가에게서 배울 점이 많습니다.

full- src: All this political posturing aside,
I really feel we're witnessing the birth of a new Europe,
full- tr: 지금 우리는 새로운 유럽의 탄생을 목격하는 중입니다.

full- src: where business is the true international language.
full- tr: 그곳에서는 비즈니스가 진짜 국제 공용어가 되겠지요.

full- src: And the Orient Express, really quite remarkable if you stop to think about it.
full- tr: 그리고 오리엔트 특급만 봐도, 가만히 생각하면 참 대단한 일입니다.

full- src: Here we are, we've just crossed from Germany into Austria,
and not so much as a customs check to let you know we've crossed the border.
full- tr: 국경을 넘었다는 걸 알릴 세관 검사조차 없군요.

full- src: Now that's the new Europe.
Another year or two and frontiers will be a mere formality, a relic of the past.
full- tr: 1~2년만 더 지나면 국경은 형식만 남은, 과거의 유물이 될 겁니다.

full- src: You'll be able to travel from England to Germany as easily as
going from one end of London to the other.
full- tr: 런던 한쪽 끝에서 다른 쪽 끝으로 가는 것만큼 쉬워질 겁니다.

full- src: You would not believe sometimes the troubles I have to explain to my people.
full- tr: 제가 부하들에게 설명해야 하는 골칫거리를 들으면 아마 놀라실 겁니다.

full- src: I need to keep up with what is happening abroad,
full- tr: 해외에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 늘 파악해 둬야 하고,

full- src: to act quickly when the opportunity presents.
Oh, I assure you, half the time Home Office thinks I'm just travelling on a lark.
full- tr: 그런데 본국 내무부 쪽은 절반쯤 제가 유람이나 다닌다고 생각하더군요.

full- src: Old-fashioned attitude of course.
Ja, still I do find myself sometimes quite tired in the evening.
full- tr: 예, 그래도 저녁이 되면 몹시 피곤할 때가 있습니다.

full- src: Mein Vater...
My father had a small factory, he never left his little town.
full- tr: 제 아버지는 작은 공장을 하셨는데, 평생 그 작은 마을을 떠나지 않으셨습니다.

full- src: He was perhaps not much of a businessman.
But at the end of the day he would sleep in his own bed. And he would be at peace.
full- tr: 그래도 하루가 끝나면 늘 자기 침대에서 주무셨고, 마음도 평안하셨습니다.

full- src: I sometimes wonder if we have really gained so much.
full- tr: 가끔은 우리가 정말 많은 걸 얻은 게 맞나 싶습니다.

full- src: I uh, couldn't help noticing you with Miss Wolff at lunch.
full- tr: 점심때 미스 볼프와 함께 계신 게 눈에 띄더군요.

full- src: You made quite a striking pair. May I ask if you've known her long?
full- tr: 아주 눈에 띄는 한 쌍이셨습니다. 오래 아신 사이인지 여쭤봐도 될까요?

full- src: Long? Well you know I'm a great admirer of her music...
full- tr: 오래라니요? 뭐, 저는 그녀의 음악을 무척 좋아합니다만...

full- src: Aren't we all...
But you seem to have a special connection with her, am I wrong?
full- tr: 그래도 두 분 사이엔 뭔가 특별한 인연이 있어 보이더군요. 제가 틀렸습니까?

full- src: Come on, you can speak freely. We're all gentlemen here.
full- tr: 자, 편하게 말씀하시죠. 여기 있는 사람들 다 신사 아닙니까.

full- src: In that case, I will admit that travelling has it's compensations.
full- tr: 그렇다면 인정하지요. 여행에도 나름의 보상은 있군요.

full- src: You can trust me I won't breath a word. Soul of discretion.
full- tr: 저를 믿으십시오. 입 밖에 한마디도 내지 않겠습니다. 비밀은 철저히 지키는 편이라서요.

full- src: By the way, what do you make of this Austro-Hungarian ultimatum?
full- tr: 그건 그렇고, 이번 오스트리아-헝가리 최후통첩은 어떻게 보십니까?

full- src: It looks like a rather nasty business.
The note is harsh, but I believe necessary.
These Balkan regions have always needed a strong hand to bring stability.
full- tr: 발칸 지역은 늘 강한 손이 있어야 안정을 찾는 법입니다.

full- src: Stability, yes, yes, that's just where we must stand together.
full- tr: 안정, 그렇지요. 바로 그 점에서 우리가 뜻을 같이해야 합니다.

full- src: Of course we all have our little differences,
but I can't help feeling that at some fundamental level
the goals of England and Germany are not so very far apart.
full- tr: 영국과 독일의 목표는 그리 멀리 떨어져 있지 않다는 생각이 듭니다.

full- src: I'm glad to hear you say it.
But do tell me I'd be quite fascinated to know, how did you begin your career?
full- tr: 그보다 정말 궁금합니다만, 경력을 어떻게 시작하셨는지 들려주시겠습니까?

full- src: Well... it's really a very simple story...
Well, off I go. Are you getting off in Vienna?
full- tr: 그럼 저는 이만 가보겠습니다. 비엔나에서 내리십니까?

full- src: This was my intention, but my plans have changed.
I have decided to remain on the train until Budapest.
Ah, taking advantage of an unexpected business opportunity, are we?
full- tr: 아, 뜻밖의 사업 기회를 잡으신 겁니까?

full- src: Act quickly and all that?
full- tr: 기회가 오면 바로 움직여야 한다는 그 원칙대로요?

full- src: It... wouldn't be the violin business now by any chance, would it?
full- tr: 설마... 그게 바이올린과 관련된 일은 아니겠지요?

full- src: This is something that I will discuss over dinner tonight.
full- tr: 그건 오늘 저녁 식사 자리에서 얘기할 문제입니다.

full- src: Special dinner with wine and champagne.
full- tr: 와인과 샴페인을 곁들인 특별한 저녁 식사에서요.

full- src: It is possible that I will take some music lessons when I am in Budapest.
full- tr: 부다페스트에 있는 동안 음악 레슨을 좀 받을지도 모르겠습니다.

full- src: Oh, perhaps I'll meet you on the return trip and you can tell me all about it.
full- tr: 아, 돌아오는 길에 다시 뵙게 되면 자세히 들려주시지요.

full- src: Maybe by then I will be able to play for you.
full- tr: 그때쯤이면 제가 직접 연주해 드릴 수 있을지도 모르겠군요.

full- src: Oh I've most enjoyed our little chat. Good evening sir.
full- tr: 짧은 대화였지만 정말 즐거웠습니다. 좋은 저녁 되십시오.

full- src: Good evening.
Is everything all right, monsieur?
Yes, fine. Thank you.
Bon appetit, monsieur.
Good evening, I saw you in the dining car but I didn't want to bother you.
full- tr: 좋은 저녁입니다. 식당칸에서 뵈었지만 방해가 될까 봐 말을 못 걸었습니다.

full- src: Did you enjoy your dinner?
Dinner was satisfactory, yes.
Must be delightful to be able to dine with your family every night.
full- tr: 매일 가족과 저녁을 함께할 수 있다니 참 좋으시겠습니다.

full- src: That's the worst part about travelling, all those meals alone.
full- tr: 여행의 가장 괴로운 점은 늘 혼자 식사해야 한다는 거지요.

full- src: The loneliness rather gets to you after a while.
full- tr: 그러다 보면 외로움이 꽤 크게 다가옵니다.

full- src: My problem is the opposite one, Monsieur.
Oh yes, well I can see that... really.
Interesting.
Look here, we'll be in Budapest in half an hour,
my company has a pretty good understanding with the Austro-Hungarian authorities.
full- tr: 저희 회사는 오스트리아-헝가리 당국과 관계가 꽤 좋습니다.

full- src: I think if you let me speak to them first,
I can explain what happened here and get this mess cleared up without a lot of fuss.
full- tr: 여기서 무슨 일이 있었는지 설명하고 이 복잡한 일을 큰 소란 없이 정리할 수 있습니다.

full- src: No need to splash it all over the papers.
Reputation of the line to think of, and all that. There's a good fellow.
full- tr: 노선의 명성도 생각해야 하지 않겠습니까. 서로 좋게 처리합시다.

full- src: Excuse me.
Excuse me.
Who is it?
I don't want to frighten you, but
I think someone went into my compartment while I was at dinner.
full- tr: 제가 저녁 먹는 동안 누군가 제 객실에 들어왔던 것 같아요.

full- src: No!
Would you think I was very silly if I ask you to keep it for me?
full- tr: 제가 이걸 잠시 맡아달라고 하면, 어리석다고 생각하시겠어요?

full- src: Just until we reach Vienna.
Of course not! I would be glad too.
You mustn't tell anybody.
It will be our secret.
Yes? Who is it?
Yes, who is it?
Madame, welcome.
Good evening.
Madame's presence is a great honor for us.
Your usual table is ready.
If madame will permit me...
Thank you.
If I may say so, madame is like a shining star, and we're all basking in your light.
full- tr: 말씀드려도 된다면, 마담은 빛나는 별 같으시고 저희는 그 빛을 받는 셈입니다.

full- src: I'm your servant, madame.
Thank you, Pascale.
Enjoy your dinner, madame.
Yes Madame? Have you made your choice?
Yes. I'll have the beef filet.
The filet de boeuf jardiniere, very good. Is Madame dining alone?
full- tr: 필레 드 뵈프 자르디니에르, 좋습니다. 오늘은 혼자 식사하십니까, 마담?

full- src: Yes.
Very good, Madame.
The filet de boeuf jardiniere.
Thank you.
Will there be anything else Madame? No? Bon appetit.
full- tr: 더 필요하신 건 없으십니까, 마담? 없으시면 맛있게 드십시오.

full- src: Excuse me.
What is it? What's wrong?
When I came back from the concert, the egg was gone.
I thought it would be safe there.
Don't worry. It's not your fault.
It's so kind.
But it's because of me that you have lost the egg.
full- tr: 하지만 당신이 알을 잃은 건 제 탓이에요.

full- src: It was so beautiful.
Why do people steal things?
Excuse me, Madame. I am really sorry.
But we have received a complaint about the barking.
full- tr: 하지만 짖는 소리에 대한 항의가 들어왔습니다.

full- src: Oh no.
Of course, for you we have always made an exception,
full- tr: 물론 마담께는 늘 예외를 드려 왔습니다만,

full- src: but now that a passenger has complained...
Must he go to the baggage car?
The passenger has insisted, Madame. What can I do?
full- tr: 승객이 강하게 요구했습니다, 마담. 저도 어쩔 수가...

full- src: Just a moment.
Oh, my darling, don't be sad.
You'll be fine in the baggage car.
Come here, precious...
Forgive me, madame.
You make sure he has plenty of water.
He really does not like the baggage car.
Of course, madame.
You are kind.
I'm very, very sorry.
Good dog. Good doggy.
You hear this?
He doesn't seem to want to stay away.
full- tr: 아무래도 거기 머물 생각이 없는 모양입니다.

full- src: Thank you, madame.
I don't understand how.
You are to keep him tighter.
I'll make sure this time.
Oh, Max, you poor thing.
You really don't like the baggage car, do you.
But you have to go back. You can't travel here with me.
full- tr: 그래도 다시 가야 해. 여기서 나랑 함께 다닐 순 없어.

full- src: Max! How did you get here?
I know, you really don't like the baggage car.
Oh, precious, what am I going to do with you?
full- tr: 오, 우리 예쁜이, 널 어쩌면 좋니?

full- src: I have to send you back. There's no way around it.
full- tr: 다시 보내야 해. 달리 방법이 없어.

full- src: Ah, miss Wolff. Please, let me help you.
Oh, thank you.
Are you comfortable? Yes, I am so glad.
Everybody wanted to sit in your seat.
I have been like a soldier fighting them away.
- Oh, really? - I would not let anybody sit here.
full- tr: - 정말요? - 누구도 여기 앉게 하지 않았습니다.

full- src: Ah, miss Wolff. Please, let me help you.
Oh, thank you.
Every time I see you, I am happy that I took this train and not the next one.
full- tr: 당신을 볼 때마다 다음 열차가 아니라 이 열차를 타길 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다.

full- src: Are you comfortable there?
Oh, yes.
You don't want to change seats?
Oh, no.
Good.
What shall we order?
Shall we get some wine?
That would be lovely.
I think good red wine, yes?
Or, forgive me, perhaps you would like something lighter?
full- tr: 아니면, 실례지만 더 가벼운 걸 원하십니까?

full- src: My father drank red wine and I'm afraid I picked up the habit.
full- tr: 아버지가 레드와인을 드셨는데, 저도 그 버릇이 들었나 봐요.

full- src: I know it's not very lady-like.
Nonsense.
We will be able to share a bottle.
full- tr: 한 병쯤은 같이 비울 수 있겠지요.

full- src: I hope I will not get drunk, haha.
Why?
Why, I'm turning into a happy little devil,
full- tr: 왜냐하면, 저는 신이 나면 작은 악마가 되거든요.

full- src: especially when I'm surrounded by a beautiful lady.
full- tr: 특히 아름다운 숙녀와 함께 있으면 더 그렇습니다.

full- src: You are a charmer.
Good afternoon Monsieur, Madame. Have you made your choice?
Madame and I will have both the roast chicken and we begin with the fish soup.
full- tr: 마담과 저는 둘 다 로스트 치킨으로 하고, 먼저 생선 수프로 시작하겠습니다.

full- src: Oh thank you.
And a bottle of your best Chateau Lafite 1904.
full- tr: 그리고 샤토 라피트 1904 중 가장 좋은 걸로 한 병.

full- src: Very good Monsieur.
On the train the wine is ruined anyway, by the vibration.
full- tr: 열차에서는 진동 때문에 와인이 어차피 상해 버리지요.

full- src: I have drunk too much wine. I am a little bit dizzy, haha.
full- tr: 와인을 너무 많이 마셨네요. 조금 어지러워요, 하하.

full- src: But you also have drunk, fraulein Wolff.
I have been pressed.
I know, I don't show it.
Shall we have our coffee in the smoking car?
That would be lovely.
Shall we sit here?
I think this will be more comfortable, don't you?
full- tr: 여기가 더 편할 것 같은데, 그렇지요?

full- src: I have eaten so much, I could just lie down on one of these couches
full- tr: 너무 많이 먹어서 이 소파에 그냥 드러눕고 싶을 정도예요.

full- src: and go to sleep.
Go right ahead, I will wake you when we reach Constantinople.
full- tr: 그러시죠. 콘스탄티노플에 도착하면 제가 깨워 드리겠습니다.

full- src: I thought you were getting off in Vienna?
Ah, yes, I had forgotten.
Is it very tiresome, your business in Vienna?
Well. You know, you always hope that a man will keep his word.
full- tr: 음, 아시다시피 사람은 약속을 지켜 주길 바라게 마련이지요.

full- src: When he does not, one hits to lose a good bit of business, but...
full- tr: 그렇지 않으면 꽤 큰 거래를 잃게 되지만...

full- src: ...one has no choice.
Then your deal isn't happening? It's been called off?
full- tr: 그럼 그 거래는 안 되는 건가요? 취소된 거예요?

full- src: Oh. Here comes a waiter.
Do you take milk?
Just sugar, two lumps.
Oh, you like it sweet.
Jacques, would you lock my door while I'm away?
full- tr: 자크, 내가 없는 동안 내 방 문 좀 잠가줄래요?

full- src: Thank you, Jacques.
You're welcome, madame.
Thank you, Jacques.
You're welcome, madame.
Pardon me, madame. Let me unlock that for you.
Thank you, Jacques.
I'm sorry to be a nuisance. I hate locked doors.
full- tr: 번거롭게 해서 미안해요. 전 잠긴 문이 정말 싫거든요.

full- src: No trouble at all, mademoiselle. It's a pleasure to open the door for you.
full- tr: 전혀 번거롭지 않습니다, 마드무아젤. 문을 열어드리는 건 제 기쁨입니다.

full- src: I'm sorry to be a nuisance. I'm sure it's perfectly safe.
full- tr: 번거롭게 해서 미안해요. 사실 아주 안전한 건 아는데도요.

full- src: You know if Max was here I wouldn't even bother.
full- tr: 맥스만 여기 있으면 이런 부탁도 안 했을 거예요.

full- src: Please, madame.
That's what I am here for.
full- tr: 제가 여기 있는 이유가 바로 그겁니다.

full- src: Thank you, Jacques.
- This is the conductor, Madame. - Come in.
Jacques, I've got the most awful headache.
Would you tell herr Schmidt I won't be having dinner with him tonight?
full- tr: 헤어 슈미트께 오늘 밤은 함께 저녁을 못 하겠다고 전해주시겠어요?

full- src: Of course, madame. Can I bring you anything?
No. I'm just tired.
I hope you can get some rest tonight.
full- tr: 오늘 밤은 푹 쉬실 수 있으면 좋겠습니다.

full- src: Thank you, Jacques.
Cognac, please.
Very good, madame.
Thank you.
Come in.
Attnang 1:57 pm
Yes, Monsieur.
Would you tell herr Whitney that August Schmidt is waiting for him?
full- tr: 헤어 휘트니께 아우구스트 슈미트가 기다리고 있다고 전해주시겠습니까?

full- src: I'm sorry, Monsieur. What did you say the gentleman's name was?
full- tr: 죄송합니다, 무슈. 그 신사 성함이 뭐라고 하셨지요?

full- src: The message is for Tyler Whitney.
Compartment 1 in the first sleeping car.
I have been waiting for some time.
Yes, Monsieur. And please forgive me for my lack of comprehension.
full- tr: 예, 무슈. 제가 제대로 못 알아들어 죄송합니다.

full- src: Excuse me.
Yes, who is it?
Herr Whitney, this is August Schmidt.
Would you open the door, please?
Herr Whitney, open the door!
Excuse me, Fraulein Wolff.
I could not leave the room without paying you my compliments.
full- tr: 인사를 드리지 않고는 자리를 뜰 수가 없어서요.

full- src: I'm sure you do not remember me.
My name is August Schmidt.
But I do remember you.
It was at Mrs Lauder's in London, wasn't it?
full- tr: 런던 로더 부인 댁에서였지요, 그렇지 않습니까?

full- src: Yes. You played Brahms violin concerto.
How lovely of you to remember.
And... you were with an English woman.
Was she a wife?
Hm... yes... hm... that is... Forgive me for interrupting your dinner.
full- tr: 흠... 네... 그러니까... 식사 중에 방해해 죄송합니다.

full- src: May I say that I'm delighted that we are sharing this journey?
full- tr: 이 여정을 함께하게 되어 기쁘다는 말씀을 드려도 될까요?

full- src: You're very kind. Good evening.
Do you know when I saw you in London, I thought you were English.
full- tr: 런던에서 처음 뵀을 때는 영국인인 줄 알았습니다.

full- src: Not really.
Yes, really.
My wife is English.
Perhaps because of this.
It's more than that.
It's the way you dress, the way you carry yourself.
And, of course, you speak English so beautifully.
I would never have believed you were German.
Is that all? Ha-ha.
But really, miss Wolff, your own English is also very good.
full- tr: 하지만 정말로, 미스 볼프의 영어도 아주 훌륭합니다.

full- src: Oh, I could go on talking like this forever.
full- tr: 아, 이렇게라면 밤새 이야기할 수도 있겠네요.

full- src: But... I'm so tired, I can hardly keep my eyes open.
full- tr: 하지만... 너무 피곤해서 눈을 뜨고 있기가 힘들어요.

full- src: I too wish we could go on talking forever!
full- tr: 저도 영원히 이야기를 계속하고 싶은 마음입니다!

full- src: Good night, herr Schmidt.
Bonsoir Monsieur. Does Monsieur wish to order dinner?
Yes, I will have the roast duck and... a bottle of '96 Bordeaux.
full- tr: 예, 로스트 덕으로 하고... 96년 보르도 한 병 주세요.

full- src: Very good Monsieur.
Here, Monsieur, is the roast duck.
Thank you.
Excuse me.
Excuse me.
Excuse me, please.
Excuse me.
Yes?
Yes?
Who is it outside?
Who is it?
Come in.
Yes, come in!
Please come in.

full- tr: 왜 우리만 초대하고 마담 부타렐은 안 불렀을까?

full- src: Then you don't think we should accept?

I don't even know what he looks like.
I didn't ask for his life story.
full- tr: 그 사람 인생사를 묻는 게 아니야.

full- src: Just knock and tell him Mr. Schmidt is waiting for him in the restaurant.
full- tr: 문 두드리고 슈미트 씨가 식당칸에서 기다린다고만 전해.

full- src: He's been waiting for some time.
Of course, Uncle. Right away.
And don't call me Uncle!
I'm sorry, Uncle- I mean sir. Forgive me.
full- tr: 죄송합니다, 아저... 아니, 선생님. 용서해 주세요.

full- src: Apart from that, everything fine?
Everything's fine. Except the gentleman in number 4.
He's got four compartments full of veiled women
full- tr: 베일 쓴 여자들이 객실 네 칸이나 있고

full- src: and whenever I pass he glares at me as if I'm trying to rape them.
full- tr: 제가 지나가기만 하면 마치 내가 무슨 짓이라도 할 사람처럼 노려봐요.

full- src: You know who they belong to, don't you?
Mahmud Makhta. That's what it says on the list.
That's the bodyguard's name. They're being very discreet because...
full- tr: 그건 경호원 이름이야. 저렇게 극비로 움직이는 건...

full- src: Really! Him?
I don't believe it!
So treat them carefully, eh?
But, Uncle, you know I'm a married man!
full- tr: 하지만 아저씨, 저 유부남인 거 아시잖아요!

full- src: Now you, on the other hand...
I told you not to call me Uncle!
That's enough joking. Now do your job.
Good evening, Uncle.
How's it going?
Good evening, sir.
Good evening, Coudert. Have you forgotten something?
full- tr: 좋은 저녁이네, 쿠데르. 뭐 빠뜨린 건 없나?

full- src: I don't think so, sir.
The passenger list perhaps?
But... didn't Mr. Mertens give it to you?
My nephew?
He said he would take it to you. That was over an hour ago...
full- tr: 가져다드리겠다고 했습니다. 벌써 한 시간도 넘었는데...

full- src: That's strange.
Ah! Perhaps it was my mistake.
Then he did give it to you!
What I mean to say is, I didn't realize he was responsible for both lists.
full- tr: 제 말은, 그가 두 객차 명단을 다 맡고 있는 줄은 몰랐다는 겁니다.

full- src: That no doubt explains it. Thank you, Coudert.
Of course, sir.
Good evening, Uncle.
Have you forgotten something?
Er...no...you must mean the passenger list...
full- tr: 어... 아니요... 승객 명단 말씀하시는 거죠...

full- src: Well, I can't seem to find it anywhere.
You can't find it? What?
It was here in my magazine, I had it all ready to bring it to you.
full- tr: 여기 잡지 속에 넣어 두고 갖다드리려 했는데

full- src: I can't imagine it fell out, but I've looked everywhere.
full- tr: 빠졌을 리는 없는데, 샅샅이 다 찾아봤습니다.

full- src: And Coudert's?
They were together.
This is too much. What will I say in my report?
full- tr: 정말 기가 막히는군. 보고서에 뭐라고 쓰지?

full- src: My lazy, incompetent nephew, who only got this job because I backed him,
full- tr: 내가 밀어 넣어 준 덕에 들어온 게으르고 무능한 조카가,

full- src: lost the passenger lists for both sleeping cars?
full- tr: 침대칸 두 대의 승객 명단을 몽땅 잃어버렸다?

full- src: I think you'd better find that list before we reach Budapest.
full- tr: 부다페스트 도착 전까지 그 명단 찾아와.

full- src: Yes, Uncle. I'm sorry, Uncle. It must be here somewhere.
full- tr: 예, 아저씨. 죄송해요, 아저씨. 여기 어딘가 있을 겁니다.

full- src: When I was your age I was still carrying bags.
full- tr: 내가 네 나이엔 짐이나 나르고 있었어.

full- src: Kids today, life is too easy for them. They don't appreciate anything.
full- tr: 요즘 것들은 세상이 너무 편해. 고마운 줄을 몰라.

full- src: Good evening, Coudert. Is everything OK?
Ever since the policemen left, everything is fine.
And the passengers?
Mrs. Boutarel asked a few details to satisfy her curiosity,
but with the others there were no major upsets.
OK. No need to mention all this in your report, I will take care of it.
full- tr: 좋아. 이 일은 보고서에 굳이 적지 말게, 내가 처리하지.

full- src: Very well, sir.
How did it go?
No problem... once I got them to agree to skip the harem compartments.
full- tr: 하렘 객실은 건너뛰기로 합의하고 나니 별문제 없었습니다.

full- src: You can imagine what a scene there would have been.
Two gendarmes killed on French soil by a Muslim bodyguard.
full- tr: 프랑스 땅에서 헌병 두 명이 무슬림 경호원에게 죽는다면

full- src: An international incident.
And His Excellency the Prince?
He wasn't disturbed. His African secretary handled everything.
full- tr: 건드리지 않았습니다. 아프리카인 비서가 전부 처리했습니다.

full- src: That's why they gave me such a hard time about the harem.
full- tr: 그래서 하렘 객실 문제로 저를 그렇게 들볶은 겁니다.

full- src: You know these cops, they're not used to dealing with people of class.
full- tr: 아시잖습니까, 이런 경찰들은 상류층 상대에 익숙하지 않아요.

full- src: Well, at least it's over. Enough excitement for one night.
full- tr: 그래도 끝나긴 했군. 하룻밤 소동으론 충분해.

full- src: Ah! Uncle. Good news. I found the list.
full- tr: 아! 아저씨, 좋은 소식입니다. 명단 찾았어요.

full- src: Where was it?
Ah... in my magazine where I put it. I don't know how I missed it.
full- tr: 어... 제가 넣어둔 잡지 안에 있었습니다. 왜 못 봤는지 모르겠습니다.

full- src: I looked and looked and gave up. Then I turned the page and there it was!
full- tr: 아무리 찾아도 안 보여 포기했는데, 페이지 넘기니 거기 있더군요!

full- src: Unbelievable! You're an even bigger dunce than I thought.
I was running around in circles trying to figure how to get out of this.
full- tr: 이걸 어떻게 수습하나 싶어 내가 얼마나 뛰어다녔는지 아나.

full- src: Listen, not a word about this to Coudert, understood?
full- tr: 잘 들어. 이 일은 쿠데르에게 한마디도 하지 마, 알겠나?

full- src: Of course, Uncle. I'm sorry, you can't imagine. It won't happen again.
full- tr: 물론이죠, 아저씨. 정말 죄송합니다. 다시는 이런 일 없겠습니다.

full- src: And for the last time, stop calling me Uncle!
Good day, sir.
Have you seen a master key anywhere?
No... You have lost your key?
Last night. I must have dropped it in the confusion with Count Obolensky.
full- tr: 어젯밤이요. 오볼렌스키 백작 소동 때 떨어뜨린 것 같습니다.

full- src: That key opens all the compartments on the train.
full- tr: 그 키는 열차의 모든 객실을 열 수 있어.

full- src: I hate to suggest it... but perhaps one of the passengers has stolen it?
full- tr: 이런 말은 꺼내기 싫습니다만... 혹시 승객 중 누가 훔친 건 아닐까요?

full- src: That's hard to believe. Which passenger?
Maybe the American? He looks like a troublemaker.
full- tr: 미국인일지도요? 영 문제를 몰고 다니는 인상입니다.

full- src: I've often seen him hanging around the corridor.
The doctor?
He was there last night with Count Obolensky.
full- tr: 어젯밤 오볼렌스키 백작 쪽에 함께 있었잖습니까.

full- src: With so many people, he could have taken advantage of the confusion.
full- tr: 사람이 몰린 틈에 가져갔을 수도 있습니다.

full- src: There weren't so many people. Just Miss Wolff and Miss Tatiana.
full- tr: 그리 많지도 않았어. 미스 볼프와 미스 타티아나뿐이었지.

full- src: Anyway, the key is gone. Keep a sharp lookout.
full- tr: 어쨌든 키는 사라졌어. 눈 크게 뜨고 살펴.

full- src: Yes, sir.
Arriving at Munich station. Munich, twenty minute stop.
Arriving at Salzburg station... Salzburg, ten minute stop.
Arriving at Wels station. Wels, fifteen minute stop.
The train is arriving at Amstetten station.
Amstetten, five minute stop.
Ladies and gentlemen, the train will arrive in Vienna in one hour.
full- tr: 승객 여러분, 열차는 1시간 후 비엔나에 도착합니다.

full- src: Vienna...
The train is entering Vienna's West Station.
Vienna, one hour stop.
Vienna...
First service... first service...
Lunch is served...
Second service... Second service...
Lunch is served...
Yes, sir.
If I give you an order do you think you can follow it without screwing up?
full- tr: 내가 명령을 내리면 이번엔 실수 없이 해낼 수 있겠나?

full- src: Yes, sir. Absolutely, sir.
There is going to be a concert this afternoon in His Excellency's car.
full- tr: 오늘 오후 각하 객차에서 연주회가 열린다.

full- src: Miss Wolff will be playing. A lot of people will pass through here.
full- tr: 미스 볼프가 연주할 거다. 이쪽으로 사람이 많이 지나갈 거야.

full- src: Can you make sure they find their way and other passengers aren't disturbed?
full- tr: 길 안내 잘해서 다른 승객들 방해 없게 할 수 있겠나?

full- src: Yes, sir!
Here is the guest list. If anyone else is curious and tries to get through,
full- tr: 여기 초대 명단이다. 다른 승객이 호기심에 지나가려 하면

full- src: you must stop them and explain that it is a private affair.
In the most polite way, of course.
Of course. You can count on me, Uncle.
And don't leave your post!
No- I mean yes, Uncle!
Good day, sir.
Our guest, His Excellency the Prince, is holding a concert this afternoon.
full- tr: 귀빈이신 각하께서 오늘 오후 연주회를 여십니다.

full- src: Miss Wolff will be playing the violin.
He wishes to invite certain passengers. Here is the list.
full- tr: 몇몇 승객을 초대하길 원하십니다. 여기 명단입니다.

full- src: The time is three o'clock. Please pass on His Excellency's wishes.
The Count Obolensky... his granddaughter...
Miss de Bretheuil and her friend.
Very well, sir, I will take care of it.
Good morning, Coudert. Everything all right, I hope?
Everything's fine.
Good. I'll see you later.
What can I do for you?
I'm sorry, but one of the passengers has complained about Miss Wolff's companion.
full- tr: 죄송합니다만, 승객 한 분이 미스 볼프의 동반자에 대해 항의했습니다.

full- src: To be precise, Mrs. Boutarel.
That's awkward. You couldn't talk her out of it?
It's hard. She and her husband were not invited to Miss Wolff's concert.
full- tr: 어렵습니다. 그 부부는 미스 볼프 연주회에 초대받지 못했거든요.

full- src: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned.
full- tr: 무시당한 여인의 분노만큼 무서운 건 없지.

full- src: I believe she will pursue this matter without mercy.
full- tr: 아마 이 일은 끝까지 물고 늘어질 겁니다.

full- src: Too bad. Well, rules are rules.
You'll have to break the news to Miss Wolff. And move the dog.
full- tr: 이 소식은 자네가 미스 볼프에게 전하게. 그리고 그 개도 치우고.

full- src: Me, sir?
Yes, you. Why- are you afraid of dogs?
No, sir. I love animals.
All right. Do your best.
Be sure you apologize to Miss Wolff. Remember she's one of our best clients.
full- tr: 미스 볼프께는 꼭 사과드리게. 우리 단골 중에서도 가장 중요한 손님이야.

full- src: She's taken the Paris-Constantinople more times than you have.
full- tr: 자네보다 파리-콘스탄티노플 노선을 더 많이 타신 분이니까.

full- src: I know that, sir.
Pozsony... the train is arriving in Pozsony Station.
Three minute stop.
The train is arriving in Galanta station.
Galanta... Five minute stop.
Ladies and gentlemen, the train will arrive in Budapest in one hour.
full- tr: 승객 여러분, 열차는 1시간 후 부다페스트에 도착합니다.

full- src: Ladies and gentlemen, the train will arrive in Budapest in half an hour.
full- tr: 승객 여러분, 열차는 30분 후 부다페스트에 도착합니다.

full- src: The train is arriving at Budapest station.
Budapest, twenty minute stop...
Ladies and gentlemen, if you please,
stay calm and remain in your compartments
and keep your doors closed.
There is no reason to panic. Just stay where you are.
full- tr: 당황하실 필요 없습니다. 계신 자리에서 기다려 주십시오.

full- src: Vienna 6:00 pm
Excuse me.
Excuse me.
Pardon, monsieur.
Excuse me.
Excuse me, monsieur.
Excuse me, monsieur.
Who is it?
Don't open it!
Don't be an idiot, of course I'm not going to open it!
full- tr: 바보 같은 소리 마, 당연히 안 열 거야!

full- src: Yes, who is it?
Please Monsieur, in here we are only people who work in the kitchen.
full- tr: 제발, 무슈. 여긴 주방에서 일하는 사람들뿐입니다.

full- src: My comrade here is a good socialist,
full- tr: 여기 있는 제 동지도 훌륭한 사회주의자고,

full- src: he has always been a strong supporter of Monsieur Jaures.
But who are they?
They're not ordinary thieves, I'm sure this is political.
full- tr: 보통 도둑들은 아닙니다. 분명 정치적인 일이에요.

full- src: Something to do with the Balkans.
It's obvious they're anarchists.
The young man who was killed was one of them.
full- tr: 죽은 그 청년도 그들 중 하나였고요.

full- src: They want to blow up the train and kill us all.
full- tr: 열차를 폭파해서 우리를 다 죽이려는 거예요.

full- src: You don't know what you're talking about.
What's that supposed to mean?
Anarchist yourself!
Why are we stuck here?
You young people don't know anything.
It's incredible that they let you work in a kitchen on a deluxe train
full- tr: 자네가 이런 호화열차 주방에서 일하도록 내버려 두다니,

full- src: when you don't know the first thing about safety.
Of course everyone must go to the back of the train, it's the safest place.
full- tr: 당연히 모두 열차 뒤쪽으로 가야지, 거기가 제일 안전해.

full- src: What do you mean? There's going to be a collision?
Is it so hard to understand? They've cut the brakes, the alarm doesn't work.
full- tr: 그게 그렇게 이해가 안 되나? 브레이크가 끊겼고 경보도 안 울린다고.

full- src: Obviously they took control of the train at the last stop.
full- tr: 놈들이 지난 정차역에서 열차를 장악한 게 분명해.

full- src: You think these bandits know how to drive a train? Anything could happen.
full- tr: 그 산적들이 열차를 제대로 몰 줄 알겠어? 무슨 일이든 날 수 있어.

full- src: They're going to kill us all...
Shut up, idiot!
Wels 2:23 pm
Oh I'm travelling on business. Every now and then the company has a little matter
full- tr: 아, 출장 중입니다. 가끔 회사에서 처리할 일이 생겨요.

full- src: to take care of on the continent so off I go.
full- tr: 대륙 쪽에서 말이죠. 그러면 제가 나서는 겁니다.

full- src: I say! I think you've got the wrong compartment.
full- tr: 이런, 객실을 잘못 찾아오신 것 같습니다.

full- src: Looks like we've both got the wrong compartment.
full- tr: 보아하니 우리 둘 다 객실을 잘못 찾았군요.

full- src: Care to join me in a drink? Just the two of us, man to man.
I'll be in the smoking car.
Unfortunate, what happened to him.
full- tr: 그 사람에게 그런 일이 생기다니 안됐군요.

full- src: Me, I've always felt that when push came to shove
full- tr: 저는 늘 생각했어요, 결정적인 순간이 오면

full- src: you'd turn out to be one of our sort, what do you think?
full- tr: 당신도 결국 우리 같은 부류가 될 거라고. 어떻게 생각합니까?

full- src: I can take no pleasure in food, while millions of my countrymen go without bread.
full- tr: 수많은 동포가 빵조차 못 먹는데 저만 식사를 즐길 순 없습니다.

full- src: Vassili Alexandrovitch, I am Alexei Dolnikov.
I believe you knew my father.
It's a Russian fairy tale. For children.
If Vassili Alexandrovich suffers, it's because of his own guilty conscience.
full- tr: 바실리 알렉산드로비치가 괴로운 건 본인 양심이 찔리기 때문입니다.

full- src: I only spoke the truth.
How dare you!
A single deed is better propaganda than a thousand pamphlets.
full- tr: 행동 하나가 전단 천 장보다 더 강한 선전이야.

full- src: There is good and bad in everyone, Tatiana.
full- tr: 누구에게나 선과 악은 함께 있어, 타티아나.

full- src: But Vassili Obolensky is one of the most evil products of
the most evil system ever invented by man on Earth!
full- tr: 인간이 만든 가장 사악한 체제가 낳은 최악의 산물 중 하나야!

full- src: What do the victims matter? It's the meaning of the act that counts!
full- tr: 희생자가 무슨 상관이야? 중요한 건 행위의 의미다!

full- src: Haven't we met somewhere before?
full- tr: 우리 전에 어디선가 본 적 있지 않나요?

full- src: It's possible. I don't think I would have remembered.
full- tr: 그럴 수도 있죠. 기억했을 것 같진 않네요.

full- src: We're almost to the border.
We've got to stop the train!
Why?
Why? Once we're in Serbia, they'll kill us!
full- tr: 왜냐고요? 세르비아로 넘어가면 우릴 죽일 거예요!

full- src: Constantinople?
You won't make it out of Belgrade.
I wasn't planning to stop in Belgrade.
It seems you'll make it to Constantinople after all.
Congratulations. You've won.
Is it customary in America to be so forward?
full- tr: 미국에서는 그렇게 노골적으로 구는 게 예의인가요?

full- src: Fraulein Wolff? I could not leave the room without paying you my compliments.
full- tr: 프로일라인 볼프? 인사를 드리지 않고는 방을 나갈 수가 없었습니다.

full- src: How lovely of you to remember.
I seem to remember hearing of a mister Whitney years ago in New-York.
full- tr: 몇 년 전 뉴욕에서 미스터 휘트니라는 이름을 들은 기억이 나는군요.

full- src: A woman travelling alone has to be careful.
full- tr: 여자가 혼자 여행할 때는 조심해야 하니까요.

full- src: I would have thought Max was enough protection.
Isn't she enchanting?
That violinist Miss Wolff.
She seems to be getting on rather well with Herr Schmidt.
full- tr: 헤어 슈미트와 꽤 잘 지내는 것 같군.

full- src: Not her type, I would have thought...
- Shall we say 3 o'clock? - I shall count the minutes until then.
full- tr: - 그럼 3시로 할까요? - 그때까지 분을 세며 기다리겠습니다.

full- src: They sent you to break up Tyler's arms deal.
full- tr: 당신은 타일러의 무기 거래를 깨러 파견됐어.

full- src: You killed him and you stole the gold egg he was carrying.
full- tr: 당신이 그를 죽이고, 그가 들고 있던 황금 알까지 훔쳤지.

full- src: I didn't. It wasn't me!
I've never killed anyone! I swear it!
full- tr: 난 누구도 죽인 적 없어! 맹세해!

full- src: I'm very tired. Please, let me go.
Monsieur Whitney, excuse me.
Herr Schmidt is waiting for you in the restaurant car.
Herr Whitney, I will come to your compartment in 5 minutes.
full- tr: 헤어 휘트니, 5분 후 당신 객실로 가겠습니다.

full- src: The merchandise will be put on the train at Munich.
It is what we agreed.
Good. We'll talk again after Munich.
full- tr: 좋소. 뮌헨을 지난 뒤 다시 이야기하지.

full- src: The merchandise has been loaded onto the train.
I want to see the gold.
I want to see the gold. If you cannot reassure me,
I intend to get off in Vienna and take my merchandise with me!
full- tr: 비엔나에서 내려 물건을 도로 가져갈 생각이오!

full- src: Yes. Yes.
Not so fast, herr Schmidt. We're not in Belgrade yet.
full- tr: 서두르지 마시오, 헤어 슈미트. 아직 베오그라드에 도착하지 않았소.

full- src: Where does the fatherland's interest lie in arming a band of Serbian terrorists?
full- tr: 세르비아 테러리스트들을 무장시키는 일이 조국의 이익과 무슨 관련이 있습니까?

full- src: The last time I looked at a newspaper, Serbia was allied to Russia and France.
full- tr: 제가 마지막으로 신문을 봤을 때 세르비아는 러시아와 프랑스 편이었는데요.

full- src: Your question is not a bad one.
I leave it to you to find the answer.
No! I found it, it's mine!
full- tr: 안 돼! 내가 찾았어, 이건 내 거야!

full- src: I saw a black beetle...
Monsieur Whitney, excuse me.
His excellency wishes to receive you in his private car.
full- tr: 각하께서 개인 객차에서 당신을 뵙길 원하십니다.

full- src: Whether you are Cath or Whitney is a matter of indifference to me.
full- tr: 당신이 캐스든 휘트니든 내겐 중요하지 않습니다.

full- src: I am prepared to continue the discussion begun by my agent in Paris
full- tr: 파리에 있는 내 대리인이 시작한 협상을 계속할 의향은 있습니다.

full- src: provided that you have the piece of which you spoke.
I am prepared to continue the discussion begun by my agent in Paris
full- tr: 파리에 있는 내 대리인이 시작한 협상을 계속할 의향은 있습니다.

full- src: provided that you have the piece of which you spoke.
It was called a firebird. I never saw it.
full- tr: 그건 불새라고 불렸소. 난 본 적 없소.

full- src: Do you have the firebird?
I have brought with me a rather heavy briefcase.
I would like to know now if the proposed exchange interests you
full- tr: 이제 제안한 교환에 당신이 관심이 있는지 알고 싶군요.

full- src: and if you are capable of completing it.
full- tr: 그리고 그걸 끝까지 성사시킬 능력이 있는지도요.

full- src: It's been a pleasure doing business with you, mister Whitney.
I myself must leave the train in Vienna.
In case we do not see each other again I wish you a pleasant journey to Istanbul.
full- tr: 다시 못 뵙게 되더라도, 이스탄불까지 즐거운 여정 되시길 바랍니다.

full- src: Where's the gold?
What gold? I saw a wooden box and a hell of a mess.
full- tr: 무슨 금 말이오? 난 나무 상자랑 아수라장만 봤소.

full- src: Then we lost. How can I tell this to the general?
full- tr: 그럼 우린 끝장이군. 이걸 장군께 뭐라고 보고하지?

full- src: Tyler was to sell it for gold to buy the guns from the German.
full- tr: 타일러는 그걸 금으로 바꿔 독일인에게서 총을 사기로 했소.

full- src: If the German finds out that we have lost the gold,
full- tr: 독일인이 우리가 금을 잃어버린 걸 알게 되면,

full- src: everything is lost.
You must tell him that we have the gold, and that we want to buy the guns.
full- tr: 우리가 금을 갖고 있고, 총을 사려 한다고 그에게 말해야 하오.

full- src: You're like a Slav. You are one of us!
full- tr: 당신은 슬라브인 같소. 이제 우리 사람이오!

full- src: I tell you he was afraid of something.
There was a shadow on him.
full- tr: 그 사람에겐 죽음의 그림자가 드리워져 있었소.

full- src: When I look into his eyes, he had the eyes of death.
full- tr: 그의 눈을 보면, 죽은 자의 눈빛이었소.

full- src: Tyler gave his life for our freedom. And you! What do you believe in?
full- tr: 타일러는 우리 자유를 위해 목숨을 바쳤소. 그런데 당신은! 대체 뭘 믿고 있소?

full- src: Fran뇇is! Come here!
- Where did this whistle come from? - I found it.
full- tr: - 이 호루라긴 어디서 났니? - 제가 찾았어요.

full- src: Did I dream it, or is there a dog in the compartment next to ours?
full- tr: 내가 잘못 본 건가, 아니면 우리 옆 객실에 개가 있는 건가요?

full- src: That dog ought to be in a cage in the baggage car.
full- tr: 그 개는 수하물칸 우리에 있어야 해요.

full- src: Excuse me, monsieur.
The French are so funny.
Madame Caillaux seems to have become a sort of national heroine.
full- tr: 카이요 부인은 거의 국민 영웅이 된 모양이야.

full- src: Sophie!
I'd say more Joan of Arc, really.
Who the English burned at the stake...
full- tr: 영국인들이 화형에 처한 그 잔 다르크 말이야...

full- src: Must you always bring that up?
Well, it happened...
Don't worry. He won't understand, he's an American.
full- tr: 걱정 마. 저 사람은 미국인이라 못 알아들어.

full- src: You are beautiful tonight.
What were you writing all morning?
Just my diary.
You're feeling good.
The firebird! It's beatiful. Look at his burning tail.
full- tr: 불새! 정말 아름다워. 저 불타는 꼬리 좀 봐.

full- src: Tatiana, you don't want this thing around.
full- tr: 타티아나, 그런 건 가까이 두면 안 돼.

full- src: If you don't give it back,
I'll call the conductor and have you thrown off the train.
full- tr: 차장을 불러 널 열차에서 내리게 할 거야.

full- src: Give it to me.
He said that I'm his only connection to the world
full- tr: 그 사람이 그러더군요, 내가 세상과 이어진 유일한 끈이라고

full- src: and that if I won't go with him, his life means nothing.
full- tr: 내가 함께 가지 않으면 자기 삶은 아무 의미도 없다고요.

full- src: You don't know him. I really think he might do something crazy.
full- tr: 당신은 그 사람을 몰라요. 정말 무모한 짓을 할지도 몰라요.

full- src: Please come. You're the only one I can trust.
full- tr: 꼭 와줘요. 내가 믿을 수 있는 사람은 당신뿐이에요.

full- src: Why don't you make it sing?
Did you obey all the covenants of our church?
Tatiana, get me my knife!
I will cut out his heart, I will feed it to the wolves!
Grandfather!
Don't listen to him, he doesn't know what he's saying!
full- tr: 저 사람 말 듣지 마세요, 무슨 말을 하는지도 몰라요!

full- src: Vassili Alexandrovitch!
I'm afraid the old man has quite lost his head.
Still, he has played a role for years as a sort of informal ambassador for the Tsar,
full- tr: 그래도 오랜 세월 차르의 비공식 대사 같은 역할을 해오신 분이죠,

full- src: if you know what I mean.
So, it was you in my dream!
full- tr: 그래, 내 꿈에 나온 게 바로 너였구나!

full- src: Go on- take it!
Maybe it will sing for you!
Those passengers will never arrive in Constantinople.
full- tr: 저 승객들은 결코 콘스탄티노플에 도착하지 못할 거요.

full- src: Just a minute.
